origin.description: Reads a SAS transport (.xpt) file into a tibble.
origin.usage: read_xpt(file, col_select = NULL, skip = 0, n_max = Inf, .name_repair = "unique")

arguments.name: file
arguments.text: A path or the raw bytes.

arguments.name: col_select
arguments.text: Column names or 1-based positions to keep.

origin.details: Version 5 and version 8 transport files are both read. Date and datetime columns follow the SAS format.
origin.example:
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".xpt")
write_xpt(tibble::tibble(num = c(1, 2, 3.5)), tmp, version = 8, name = "T")
print(read_xpt(tmp)$num)
unlink(tmp)

translation.description: Reads a SAS transport (.xpt) file into a tibble.

arguments.name: file
arguments.text: A path or the raw bytes.

arguments.name: col_select
arguments.text: Column names or 1-based positions to keep.

translation.details: Version 5 and version 8 transport files are both read. Date and datetime columns follow the SAS format.
translation.example:
import tempfile, os
from haven import read_xpt, write_xpt
from haven.labelled import Vector
from tibble import new_tibble
path = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".xpt")
write_xpt(new_tibble([Vector([1.0, 2.0, 3.5], "double")], nrow=3, names=["num"]), path, version=8, name="T")
print(read_xpt(path).columns[0].values)
os.remove(path)
